app.name: Windhawk Profile Manager
app.tagline: Safe profile switching for Windhawk mods on Windows 11.

shell.statusBody: The shell is ready. Profile, snapshot, and apply screens arrive next.

home.body: Machine status, the active profile, drift, and the safe next action in one place.
home.noActiveProfileBody: Choose a profile, review the plan, and apply it when you are ready.
home.rainmeterDetail: The profile can start or quit Rainmeter without touching its layouts.
home.serviceStoppedBody: Start it before applying; the engine reloads from the registry.
home.applyBlocked: Apply is disabled while Windhawk is missing or the machine is read-only.
home.noSnapshotsBody: A snapshot will be captured before the first apply, or use Back up now.
home.environmentError: Machine status could not be read

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.body: Create, edit, duplicate, capture, and import Windhawk profiles.
profiles.empty: This screen is intentionally empty until its ticket starts.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.body: Review pre-apply snapshots, restore a captured state, and export evidence.
snapshots.empty: This screen is intentionally empty until its ticket starts.

packs.title: Theme Packs
packs.body: See the Mac Blur Glass mod checklist and install the missing pieces.
packs.empty: This screen is intentionally empty until its ticket starts.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Language, appearance, Explorer restart preference, retention, and diagnostics.
settings.empty: This screen is intentionally empty until its ticket starts.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.body: Shared primitives rendered with the active theme and language.
gallery.dialogBody: Dialogs trap focus and close with Escape.
gallery.switchDescription: Ask first when a profile needs it.
gallery.checkboxLabel: Show the apply plan before writing
gallery.emptyBody: The next ticket fills this space.
gallery.errorBody: Windhawk was not found. Install it and retry.

apply.title: Review apply plan
apply.description: Review every registry change before Windows asks for administrator approval.
apply.progressBody: The run cannot be interrupted after elevation. Each step reflects the helper and journal.
apply.uacCanceled: The UAC prompt was canceled. No registry, service, Rainmeter, or Explorer changes were made.
apply.noPlan: The plan could not be loaded.
apply.snapshotNotice: A snapshot will be created before any registry write.
apply.reloadNotice: Windhawk reloads automatically; no service restart is needed.
apply.serviceStartNotice: The Windhawk service is stopped and will be started before writing.
apply.noOp: No registry or finishing action changes are needed.
apply.deleteAll: Delete all settings for this mod
apply.confirmDeleteAll: Delete all settings for this mod
apply.confirmDeleteAllBody: This cannot be undone without restoring the snapshot. Confirm explicitly to continue.
apply.unlistedDisable: The profile disables all unlisted mods.
apply.explorerNote: A mod may prompt on its own.
apply.oneRunOnly: Only one apply or restore can run at a time.
apply.serviceMissingNotice: The Windhawk service is not installed. Reinstall Windhawk before applying.

blocker.requiredMissing: This theme pack requires these mods: {{mods}}. Install them before applying.

packs.applyBlockedMissing: Apply is disabled until every required mod is installed.
packs.applyBlockedMode: Apply is disabled because Windhawk is not writable on this machine.
packs.environmentError: Environment status could not be read
packs.checklistBody: Installed means Windhawk reports a LibraryFileName for the mod.
packs.errorTitle: Theme packs could not be read
packs.emptyBody: The bundled Mac Blur Glass pack is missing. Reinstall Windhawk Profile Manager.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.body: Switch between complete Windhawk setups. Capture the current machine, edit a copy, and keep built-in profiles read-only.
profiles.missingHint: Apply skips missing mods and reports them. Install them in Windhawk for the full setup.
profiles.builtInReadOnly: Read-only. Duplicate this profile to customize it.
profiles.applyUnavailable: Apply is unavailable on this machine.
profiles.applyUnavailableZero: Apply is unavailable because this profile manages no mods.
profiles.emptyBody: Capture the current Windhawk setup to create your first profile.
profiles.emptyUserBody: Capture the current Windhawk setup, or start blank and add mods in the editor.
profiles.environmentErrorTitle: Windhawk status could not be read
profiles.environmentErrorBody: Missing-mod counts are unknown until the status refreshes. {{message}}
profiles.stateErrorTitle: Active profile status could not be read
profiles.createErrorTitle: Could not create a blank profile

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This profile will be removed. Snapshots are never deleted.

capture.title: Capture current setup
capture.description: Create a profile from the Windhawk mods and settings on this machine.
capture.name: Profile name
capture.summaryIncluded: {{count}} mods will be captured with this choice.
capture.includeDisabledBody: Disabled mods keep their settings and disabled state in the captured profile.
capture.note: Only string and dword settings are captured. Include, Exclude, Architecture, and other targeting values stay with Windhawk.
capture.successBody: "{{name}}" now reproduces this machine's current setup.
capture.environmentUnavailable: Windhawk status could not be read. Capture may fail until the environment refreshes.

editor.title: Edit {{name}}
editor.description: Choose the installed mods this profile manages, their desired state, and the actions applied with it.
editor.name: Name
editor.staleBody: Another edit changed this profile. Reload the latest revision before saving again.
editor.zeroManagedBody: Saving is allowed, but apply is unavailable until you add at least one mod.
editor.missingBody: {{count}} managed mods are not installed. You can save; apply will skip them and report it.
editor.modsBody: Check an installed mod to make this profile manage it. Unchecked mods are left untouched.
editor.modeHint: Replace treats this profile's settings as complete and deletes values it omits. Merge writes these values and leaves the rest.
editor.newModMergeHint: Newly added mods start in merge mode so their existing settings survive until settings are captured.
editor.noInstalledMods: No installed mods were found. Capture needs at least one installed mod.
editor.missingModDescription: Not installed. Apply will skip this mod.
editor.unknownModDescription: Installed status is unknown until Windhawk status refreshes.
editor.deleteAllWarning: Replace mode with no settings deletes every setting for this mod.
editor.noSettings: No settings captured for this mod.
editor.settingsReadOnly: Settings are read-only in this version. Values come from capture or import and are never invented here.
editor.targetingBody: Include, Exclude, Architecture, and custom targeting lists are not stored in profiles and cannot be edited here. Windhawk keeps managing them.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.body: Review snapshot evidence, verify checksums, restore a captured state, and export or delete .reg files.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Automatic snapshots are kept according to your retention setting. Manual and imported snapshots stay until you delete them. Snapshots are stored with user-only access and are never uploaded.

empty.title: No snapshots yet
empty.body: A snapshot is created automatically before every apply. Apply a profile to create one, or import a .reg file as evidence.

delete.title: Delete this snapshot?
delete.body: This deletes the snapshot metadata and its .reg evidence file. It cannot be undone.

restore.title: Restore this snapshot?
restore.description: Review what a restore changes before Windows asks for administrator approval.
restore.fullState: This is a full-state restore: every captured mod is reverted, including unlisted mods.
restore.noDlls: Mod DLLs and ModsWritable mod storage are not restored.
restore.preRestore: A pre-restore snapshot is created before the first registry write.
restore.service: The Windhawk service stays running; the engine reloads changed settings.
restore.newerMods: Mods installed after this snapshot are left in place.
restore.missingKeys: Captured mods whose registry key no longer exists are skipped and listed.
restore.progressBody: The run cannot be interrupted after elevation. The service stays running while captured values are reconciled.
restore.preRestoreKept: A pre-restore snapshot was created and is available in the list.
restore.rolledBackBody: The registry was returned to its pre-restore state. The pre-restore snapshot is still available.
restore.manualRecoveryBody: Automatic rollback failed. The pre-restore snapshot was kept. Restore it from the list, or review the journal before closing Windhawk.
restore.failedBody: The pre-restore snapshot is kept so you can try again or roll back manually.
restore.uacCanceled: The UAC prompt was canceled; no changes were made.
restore.targetingBody: These values control which processes receive the mod. They came from another machine or an imported .reg file and may not be valid here.
restore.targetingConfirm: I understand these targeting values will be written
restore.targetingConfirmBody: Review the values above before restoring.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Control language, appearance, Explorer restarts, snapshot retention, and support diagnostics. Everything stays on this PC.
settings.stateStale: Settings could not be refreshed; showing the last saved values.
settings.footer: Diagnostics never include registry values, settings values, or personal paths.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.body: Changes save immediately and apply without a restart.

language.title: Language
language.body: Follow the Windows display language, or choose Thai or English.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.body: Follow the Windows theme, or force light or dark.

explorer.title: Explorer restart
explorer.body: Ask before restarting Explorer when a mod needs it, always restart, or never restart.

retention.title: Snapshot retention
retention.body: Choose how many automatic pre-apply snapshots to keep. This limit never applies to manual or imported snapshots.
retention.range: Enter a whole number from 5 to 50.
retention.invalid: Enter a whole number from 5 to 50.
retention.note: A snapshot referenced by an unfinished run is kept even when the limit is reached.

environment.readyBody: Windhawk is installed and compatible, so profiles can be applied.
environment.issuesFallback: Windhawk Profile Manager cannot write to Windhawk on this system.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Support information without registry values, settings values, or personal paths.
diagnostics.stale: Diagnostics could not be refreshed; showing the last result.

actions.title: Support actions
actions.body: Logs and data stay on this PC. Nothing is uploaded.
actions.openFailed: The folder could not be opened

firstRun.title: Welcome to Windhawk Profile Manager
firstRun.body: Windhawk Profile Manager saves named Windhawk mod setups as profiles and applies them safely. Here is what changes before anything is written.
firstRun.loadErrorTitle: This PC could not be checked
firstRun.partialError: Some system details could not be loaded.
firstRun.choicesTitle: Where do you want to start?
firstRun.completeError: First-run setup could not be saved.
firstRun.hint: You can change any of this later in Settings.
firstRun.footer: No network requests are made. Profiles, snapshots, and diagnostics stay on this PC.

changes.title: Only Windhawk mod settings change
changes.body: A profile writes the enabled state and values under Windhawk's mod settings keys. Mods and Windhawk's targeting values are never deleted.

snapshot.title: A snapshot comes first
snapshot.body: Every apply captures a full pre-apply snapshot, so the previous setup can be restored.

uac.title: Admin only when applying
uac.body: Browsing, capturing, and editing need no elevation. Windows asks for administrator approval only when you apply a profile.

service.title: The Windhawk service keeps running
service.body: The engine reloads changed settings on its own. The app never stops or restarts the service on the happy path.

network.title: No network requests
network.body: Profiles, snapshots, and diagnostics stay on this PC. Nothing is uploaded.

readOnly.title: This PC is read-only
readOnly.issuesFallback: Windhawk Profile Manager cannot write to Windhawk on this system.
readOnly.applyDisabled: Apply is disabled in this mode. Continue to explore, or resolve the issue and relaunch.

choice.home: Start with the dashboard. You can apply a profile whenever you are ready.
choice.capture: Open Profiles and capture the mods enabled right now.
choice.pack: Open the Mac Blur Glass checklist and review the required mods.

recovery.title: Recover an unfinished run
recovery.description: Run {{runId}} did not finish. Review it before continuing.
recovery.warning: Some registry changes may already be in place. The pre-apply snapshot is still available.
recovery.restoreNote: Restoring applies the captured pre-apply state through the normal reconcile path. The Windhawk service stays running.
recovery.dismissNote: Keeping the current state closes the run without changing the registry. The snapshot is kept, not deleted.
recovery.restoringNote: Do not close the app while the restore is running.

result.manualRecovery: Automatic rollback failed. Keep the snapshot and review the logs before trying again.

recovery.inProgressBody: Wait for the elevated run to finish, then reload recovery. The journal is not cleared while the helper holds its lease.
recovery.finishBody: Only the non-elevated finishing actions and active-profile record remain. Finish the run without rolling it back.
recovery.finishNote: The registry changes succeeded. Finish records the active profile and runs the planned Rainmeter/Explorer actions.
recovery.corruptBody: The journal could not be parsed. Archive it to unblock apply and restore; the snapshots remain untouched.
